title: Quick Portuguese Chicken Fried Rice
description: A savory and dense Portuguese dish featuring braeburn apples and double fry KFC style chicken, made gluten free friendly. This recipe combines the flavors of Portugal with the convenience of a quick and easy meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the diced apples to the skillet and cook until they start to soften.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the apples and oil.
Add the soy sauce, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Push the rice mixture to one side of the skillet.
Add a little more oil to the other side of the skillet and scramble in the eggs.
Mix the eggs into the rice mixture.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a serving platter and top with chopped scallions.
